ReasonforDeviation_Summary: During Quarter 4, The deviation was due to extraordinary internal challenges within three associations. Welkom United Taxi Association faced leadership instability after the suspension of its Chairperson and Secretary, leaving the association at risk of non-compliance. Two associations in the Fezile Dabi District experienced serious executive committee disputes, rendering assessments impractical. Additionally, preparations for the 2025 industry-wide elections caused administrative disruptions, as many associations held early AGMs in November and December 2024. Despite these challenges, a 98.37% compliance achievement was realized, and outstanding assessments will be prioritized once leadership issues are resolved.
CorrectiveAction_Summary: Operating and Licensing Board (OLB) will implement the following corrective measures: (1) Prioritize reassessment of the outstanding three Taxi Associations as soon as their executive structures are stabilized; (2) Implement a standing contingency plan to conduct rapid assessments within a 60-day window once associations regain operational stability; These measures aim to recover the outstanding assessments early in the next quarter and maintain full oversight over association governance readiness.
